name: Outdoor Teslin armchair (stackable)
material: Teslin fabric + powder-coated metal frame with WPC piece, custom orders welcome.
description: A combination of natural wood texture and lightweight aluminum. A stylish yet warm series with a simple form created with sharp lines and the look of natural wood. The mesh fabric of the chair also gives a light impression. Since they are stackable, they can be stored efficiently when not in use. There is a handle on the top back. The mesh fabric on the seat and backrest is made of polyester, making it easy to clean.
